subject.title: Control UI chat history hardcoded to 100 messages, no load more pagination

question: Should this issue be resolved by a larger fixed Control UI history window, or should closure require an explicit older-message pagination affordance?
rationale: Current source confirms the 100-message window and backend pagination support, but the docs intentionally describe bounded recent history for stability, so the UX and payload tradeoff needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Require load-older pagination
options.body: Keep the issue open until Control UI can fetch and prepend older chat.history pages while preserving a bounded initial load.

options.title: Accept a fixed-window mitigation
options.body: Close only after maintainers intentionally accept a larger coordinated fetch/render cap and the change lands with real browser proof.

recommendation.title: Require load-older pagination
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open until Control UI can fetch and prepend older chat.history pages while preserving a bounded initial load.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the strongest current-main owner signal for both the UI history loader and the backend offset contract touched by the decision.
